repository_inventory.method: git ls-tree -r -l -z at source_commit; includes evidence, assets, generated files and source; not a line-by-line review

application_scan.method: All tracked app/**/*.gd except app/tests and app/assets; top-level functions only; exact source after removing blank/comment-only lines, expanding tabs to four spaces and trimming trailing whitespace; signatures retained; no identifier normalization; minimum eight retained lines; not semantic equivalence or deletion proof.
